summary: Post-refactor regression testing for d+p | compugrafic dual-site. Backend: all 12 pytest tests pass (contact API, Compugrafic + DP submissions, Mongo persistence, validation). Frontend: desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) both load without errors. Toggle between Compugrafic/DP works from all 3 entry points (logo, floating toggle, navbar switch). Compugrafic gallery shows 14 images, DP gallery shows 12. Contact form submits successfully and clears fields, toast shown. Mobile hamburger menu opens/closes and navigates correctly. DP hero shows watermark, left-aligned text, and SEÑALÉTICA / WAYFINDING label. No console errors. Refactor appears to have preserved all behavior correctly.

Backend: POST /api/contact seccion=compugrafic -> 200 + persisted in MongoDB
Backend: POST /api/contact seccion=dp -> 200 + persisted in MongoDB
Backend: POST /api/contact without empresa -> 200 (optional field)

Backend: Contact persistence verified via GET after POST
Backend: Default section = compugrafic
Backend: Explicit seccion=dp saved correctly
Frontend desktop: App loads, header, floating toggle, sections render
Frontend desktop: 14 Compugrafic gallery images, 12 D+P gallery images
Frontend desktop: Marquee/cenefa present
Frontend desktop: Toggle via navbar (switch-to-dp) applies dp-mode class
Frontend desktop: Toggle via floating toggle (footer-toggle-compugrafic) works

critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/contact still catches EmailStr validation inside broad try/except — Pydantic returns 422 correctly at framework level, but any unhandled DB failure is masked as generic 500 with 'Error al enviar mensaje' (consider more granular errors).
WEB3FORMS_KEY hardcoded in committed .env (not ideal for a production secret — should be set via deployment secrets).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor from 1068-line App.js to 57-line container + ~18 components preserved all behavior. All data-testid attributes retained. Backend test file located at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py — run with: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_contact_api.py -v. The test file auto-loads frontend/.env to pick up REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Web3Forms integration is live and sends real emails on each successful POST — tests use 'TEST REFACTOR' markers in name/message fields to make them identifiable for cleanup if needed.
